Hi team,

I just finished a first pass on the AWS Marketplace listing copy and the pricing matrix for the SKU mapping. I attached the draft doc and the pricing spreadsheet. TL;DR: we have two SKU configs (on-demand token pricing + reserved monthly commit) and an additional pro-tier that includes priority routing and longer KV cache retention.

Could you please:
- Quick copy pass on the product short description and value bullets (Vanessa)
- Confirm the technical callouts for GPU/quantization compat (Karthik)
- Check pricing tiers and suggested footnotes (Ben)
- Legal/finance red flags for the SKU naming/discounts (Laura)

I’m planning to send the updated package to the AWS listing team week of Jan 4 unless we discover any blockers.

Attachments:
- aws_listing_draft_v1.docx (product page copy + screenshots)
- pricing_matrix_v2.xlsx (SKU mapping + footnotes)

Thanks — short turnaround appreciated.

Best,
Soojin

On 2026-12-12 09:24, Soojin Lee wrote:
> I just finished a first pass on the AWS Marketplace listing copy and the pricing matrix for the SKU mapping.

Looks good overall. A few technical clarifications to avoid buyer confusion:
- In technical callouts, replace "supports quantized weights" with "supports INT8 and GPTQ-style quantization on supported runtimes" — that clarifies where performance varies.
- Add a note under Deployment: "Dedicated pools and Private deployments support GPU types up to A100/L40S; hosted tiers are multi-tenant and may use mixed GPU fleets."
- For KV cache retention, be explicit about per-request memory vs. per-session retention to set expectations for latency and cost.

I made inline comments in aws_listing_draft_v1.docx (track changes). No blocker from infra.

- Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: AWS Marketplace Listing Team <marketplace-listing@amazon.com>

Cc: aws-partner-program@amazon.com
Date: 2027-01-04T11:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference — listing intake questions

Hi Soojin,

Thank you for submitting the draft. Before we can approve the listing page, we need clarifications on the pricing/usage model and two compliance-related fields:

1) Pricing unit — Is per-token billing measured as input+output tokens or output-only? Please provide the exact billing unit that will appear on the SKU page.
2) Reserved capacity — Do you offer monthly commit discounts for Dedicated pools, and if so, what are the contract term options (monthly / annual)?
3) Marketplace compliance fields — Data retention policy (short summary) and whether audit logs are exportable to the buyer.

Also, provide a short (1–2 sentence) feature distinction between the Pro tier and the Standard tier we can use as a hero callout.

If you can send a consolidated response and an updated pricing_matrix_v3.xlsx, we can resume review.

Regards,
AWS Marketplace Listing Team
marketplace-listing@amazon.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: AWS Marketplace Listing Team <marketplace-listing@amazon.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-10T13:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference — listing intake questions

Hi team — thanks for the checklist. Answers below and attached revised pricing_matrix_v3.xlsx and a condensed hero line for the page. I’ve cc’d Product and Pricing for visibility.

1) Pricing unit
- Billing unit: combined input + output tokens. We will publish per-1k token pricing on the SKU page. Footnote: prompt+completion tokens measured by tiktoken-style tokenizer.

2) Reserved capacity
- We offer monthly and annual reserved commitments. Discount tiers: 10% off for monthly commit >= $10k/mo; 18% off for annual 12-month commit >= $100k/yr. Contract terms: 1 month (auto-renew) or 12 months (prepay/commit).

3) Compliance / retention / logs
- Data retention: customer data is retained for up to 30 days in hosted mode for diagnostic purposes; Dedicated and Private deployments offer configurable retention governed by customer's policy (can be set to 0 days).
- Audit logs: Exportable via S3 export (CSV/JSON) and available through the Console with 90-day retention by default (extendable via add-on).

Feature distinction (hero line):
- Standard: "Cost-efficient, multi-tenant inference with automated batching and caching for general workloads."
- Pro: "Priority isolation with extended request retention and access to priority routing and dedicated KV cache sizing."

Attachments:
- pricing_matrix_v3.xlsx (revised SKUs + footnotes)
- aws_listing_draft_v1.docx (inline edits incorporated)

Can you confirm these responses satisfy the listing requirements or if you need phrasing changes for the public page?

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee | Sr. Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
